text:
Lara Patel: Heads-up: API ref for POST /v1/embeddings still shows the single-string example (\"input\": \"...\"). Support got confused. We should standardize on batch examples (\"inputs\": [...]) and add a brief migration note.
Tom Nguyen: Where is the example coming from?
Lara Patel: docs/openapi/embeddings.yml and snippets/python/embeddings_example.py in the docs repo. Draft PR exists but CI failed.
Praneet Iyer: SDK accepts both shapes but canonical request is inputs array. Suggest changing snippets to use inputs=[...].
Maria Gomez: Also add a 2-line migration note: single-string input historically accepted; examples now use inputs array for batching and clarity. Add a curl sample showing array payload.
ci-bot: Lint: example.request.body in PR does not match schema (expected array, got object).
Tom Nguyen: I'll update the openapi example and python/curl snippets. Proposed request example:
{ "model": "rwd-embed-1", "inputs": ["The quick brown fox", "jumped over the lazy dog"] }
Tom Nguyen: Assigning to myself. Targeting EOD for fixes + CI run.
Praneet Iyer: After merge I'll sweep JS+Go snippets; they still contain two spots with 'input' as string.
Maria Gomez: I'll add the changelog one-liner linking to migration note once PR merges.
Tom Nguyen: Pushed fixes to branch. PTAL.
ci-bot: CI rerun queued.
Tom Nguyen: CI passed, merged.
Maria Gomez: Changelog PR opened referencing migration note.
Lara Patel: Thanks all. We'll monitor support for follow-ups and add FAQ if users still confuse shapes.
